concerns.text: T014d (Degenerate Detection) is listed before T015c (Orchestration Halt Logic), but T015c explicitly depends on the flag file written by T014d. While the dependency is noted in T015c's description, the task list order places T014d as a sub-task of T014 (Preprocessing) and T015c as a separate task in Phase 3. The pipeline runner (T015c) must execute AFTER T014d completes and writes the flag. The current ordering implies T015c could be scheduled before T014d finishes if the scheduler ignores the 'Depends on' text. T015c must be explicitly ordered after T014d in the execution sequence.

T030 (Load Selected Model) and T031 (SHAP for Selected) are marked [X] (complete), but T031b (SHAP for Non-Selected) is marked [ ] (pending). T035 (Model Comparison) depends on T033b (Selected Perm) and T033d (Non-Selected Perm). However, T033b and T033d depend on T031b (SHAP for Non-Selected) to generate the necessary inputs for permutation testing on the non-selected model. The current order lists T031b as pending, creating a blockage for T033d and subsequently T035. The non-selected model analysis tasks (T031b, T033c, T033d) must be scheduled immediately after T031 to ensure T035 has all required inputs.

T033a (Selected SHAP CI) and T033b (Selected Perm) are listed, but T033c (Non-Selected SHAP CI) and T033d (Non-Selected Perm) are also listed. T035 (Model Comparison) depends on T033b AND T033d. The current task list does not explicitly enforce that T033c and T033d must complete before T035. Furthermore, T033c depends on T031b (SHAP for Non-Selected), which is currently unmarked. The dependency chain T031b -> T033c -> T035 is broken by the missing T031b status and lack of explicit ordering constraints in the task list.

T014a through T014f are split into atomic sub-tasks within Phase 3. While this improves granularity, the 'Dependencies & Execution Order' section at the end of the file does not explicitly list the internal dependencies between T014a, T014b, T014c, T014d, T014e, and T014f. For example, T014c (Calculate Ev) depends on T014b (Imputation & Filtering) to ensure valid inputs. T014d (Degenerate Detection) depends on T014c to have the Ev column. T014e (Save Subsets) depends on T014d. This internal ordering should be explicitly documented in the 'Within Each User Story' section or the task descriptions to prevent parallel execution of dependent sub-tasks.
